summary: Iteration 16 - Verified eMASS-style Implementation Plan + Risk Assessment feature end-to-end. Backend: pytest tests/test_emass_fields.py 10/10 PASS (migration 0029 up/down/up, OSCAL SSP validation, openapi lists new routes, conditional required fields 422, status sync). New live-API test file test_emass_api_live.py 9/9 PASS against preview URL covering: demo-login, GET emass values on ra-5, PUT ac-3 plan with status-only -> 422 enumerating all 9 required field names ('Security Control Designation, Estimated Completion Date, Responsible Entities, SLCM Criticality, SLCM Frequency, SLCM Method, SLCM Reporting, SLCM Tracking, SLCM Comments'), invalid slcm_frequency 'Biweekly' -> 422, responsible_entities 2001 chars -> 422, slcm_comments 4001 chars -> 422, inherited ia-2.1 PUT risk -> 422 (locked), /systems/{sid}/emass/controls-payload returns mock=true with 'MOCKED' label and eMASS API names (implementationStatus/acronym), SCA persona (via /sandbox/act-as) PUT plan -> 403. Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): /login -> demo-login lands as ISSO; /systems/f47571aa.../controls/ra-5 renders [emass-panels], [emass-plan-panel], [emass-risk-panel], [emass-implementation_status]. Switching status to Planned reveals all 9 conditional fields (control_designation, estimated_completion_date, responsible_entities, slcm_frequency, slcm_method, slcm_criticality, slcm_reporting, slcm_tracking, slcm_comments). Not Applicable shows only [emass-na_justification] and hides SLCM. Manually Inherited shows [emass-common_control_provider] + SLCM. On ac-3 with Implemented+empty fields, 10 [emass-missing-*] badges appear and clicking [emass-plan-save] renders [emass-plan-error] naming every required field. [emass-suggest-btn] shows [emass-sug-banner] 'AI SUGGESTIONS - not saved' with 17 suggestions, 19 per-field sug elements and [emass-accept-all] (AI took ~5s). /ia-2.1 shows [emass-inherited-note] + [emass-risk-locked]; risk Severity select is disabled. /systems/{sid}/controls workbench has [filter-emass_status], [filter-emass_missing], [wb-export-emass-plan], [wb-export-emass-validation]; toggling 'All controls' reveals [wb-select-all] + [wb-bulk-emass-btn]; selecting [wb-select-ac-3] enables bulk button which opens [emass-bulk-modal] containing [emass-bulk-confirm].
